# 2.3 Registration in the Participant Register: why register?

The rules on access to procurement do not apply to subcontractors. Subcontracting may not be used with the intent to circumvent the rules on access to procurement.

2. Legal Entity Form7 All tenderers must provide their legal entity form signed by their legal representative. The above form must be accompanied by the evidence as indicated in the form • In case of a joint tender all economic operators shall provide the legal entity form and related evidence; • Subcontractors are only obliged to provide the legal entity form without the evidence.

To enable the Contracting Authority to verify the access, each tenderer must indicate its country of establishment (and in case of joint tender – the country of establishment of each group member) and must present the supporting evidence indicated below. The same document(s) could be used to prove country/-ies of establishment and the delegation(s) of the authorisation to sign as described in section 4.3.

Any economic operator willing to submit a tender for this call for tenders must be registered in the Participant Register - an online register of organizations and natural persons participating in European Commission's calls for tenders or proposals (participants).
